name: Vector arrows
description: Arrows of a 3-component field file on a stride lattice (the stride grows until at most max_points arrows remain), starting at the grid points, scaled by |v| (0.8 x the sample spacing for the largest arrow) and coloured by direction (stk:orientation-hsl) with the orientation legend, plus an outline and axes. Reproduces view.build's 'vectors' mode geometry for the same stride.

bindings.name: data
bindings.description: The directory (or Runtime task) holding the field file.

graph.name: Vector arrows
graph.description: stk.filter.glyph_source (stride lattice) -> instanced arrows coloured by orientation.

parameters.name: path
parameters.label: Field file
parameters.description: Path inside the binding: DAT, NPY, VTI, legacy VTK or VTKHDF (a 3-component field).
